trap.label: ativa x passiva
trap.wrong: Having been studied it, she agreed.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura as formas. Ativa: Having + pp. Passiva: Having been + pp (sujeito recebe a ação).

mcq.q: ___ raised abroad, she speaks well. (she was raised)

fix.wrong: Having been studied it, she agreed.
Having raised abroad, she speaks well.
fix.right: Having been raised abroad, she speaks well.
Not having been invited, he left.

rewrite.prompt: Ativa: “After she had studied it, she agreed.”
Passiva: “Because she had been raised abroad, she speaks well.”
rewrite.answer: Having been raised abroad, she speaks well.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva negativa: “Because he had not been invited, he left.”
rewrite.answer: Not having been invited, he left.
